none: PAS IOW-9D0338: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II as Caesar
contea di ritrovamento: Isle of Wight (Inghilterra e Galles)

A pierced Roman copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II as Caesar dating to the period AD 322-323 (Reece period 16). BEAT TRANQLITAS; Globe on altar, inscribed VOT / IS / XX reverse type. Minted at London. Mintmark: F B//PLON. RIC VII, p. 113, no. 253. Obverse: CONSTANTINVS IVN N C; Radiate, draped and cuirassed right, seen from behind. Reverse: BEAT TRANQLITAS; Globe on altar, inscribed VOT / IS /…
